target_customer: Back-end developers and small teams who need HTML and CSS from design files
problem: Turning design files into working front-end code is slow manual work; Markupwand converted PSD files into HTML and CSS templates.
business_model: Software tool for converting designs to code; later directory pages list a 29 dollar per month plan (unverified)

founders.name: Rajagopal Natarajan
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led product and engineering across software, hardware and IoT.

founders.name: Alagu M
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; the page also mislabels the batch as YCS22.

exit.reason: Cause not public; YC lists the company inactive.

technical_complexity.rationale: Producing clean, semantic HTML and CSS from layered design files automatically is a hard problem.

defensibility.rationale: No data or network effects; design-to-code competitors multiplied.

market_need_then: Not documented in sources found for 2012; PSD to HTML was a common outsourced task.

branding.domain_note: markupwand.com now redirects to a HugeDomains sale page, so the original domain is parked.
branding.brand_signature: Wand metaphor for automagic conversion, echoed in the YC tagline

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable metaphor but no press or community about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Markupwand was a three-founder Summer 2012 YC company converting PSD files to HTML and CSS. It is listed as inactive and its domain is for sale. No source states why it stopped, whether it raised money, or when, so no failure factors are assigned and the cause is not public.
notes: A low-quality aggregator (loot-drop.io) claims 2012 to 2015 operation and 120K burned; unverified and not used. A shyft.ai page describes a Markupwand supporting Figma at 29 dollars per month, which may be an unrelated revival or an auto-generated listing; not relied on. Funding searches only returned unrelated Wand App and Markup AI. Competitor search returned only undated or post-2014 pages (Macaw, Webflow) so the list is empty. Founder claims rest only on the YC page.
